name: WF-446 — Final Settlement Statement → Assignment Fee / Closing Cost / Funds Reconciliation Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const contractId=String(b.contractId??'').trim(); const settlementId=String(b.settlementId??b.statementId??'').trim(); const settlementEventId=String(b.settlementEventId??b.eventId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,dealId,contractId,settlementId,settlementEventId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Final Settlement Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const flags=[]; const settlement=ctx.settlement??ctx; const dealState=String(ctx.dealState??ctx.status??'').toLowerCase(); if(['closed','cancelled','disputed','dnc','suppressed'].includes(dealState)||ctx.dnc===true||ctx.suppressed===true)flags.push('deal_or_contact_blocked'); const statementStatus=String(settlement.status??settlement.statementStatus??'').toLowerCase(); const statementReady=['final','approved','issued','completed'].includes(statementStatus)||settlement.finalStatementReady===true; if(!statementReady)flags.push('final_settlement_statement_not_ready'); const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const expectedAssignmentFee=n(ctx.expectedAssignmentFee??ctx.assignmentFee); const actualAssignmentFee=n(settlement.actualAssignmentFee??settlement.assignmentFee); const expectedClosingCosts=n(ctx.expectedClosingCosts??ctx.closingCosts); const actualClosingCosts=n(settlement.actualClosingCosts??settlement.closingCosts); const expectedOtherCosts=n(ctx.expectedOtherCosts??ctx.otherCosts); const actualOtherCosts=n(settlement.actualOtherCosts??settlement.otherCosts); const expectedBuyerFunds=n(ctx.expectedBuyerFunds??ctx.buyerFunds); const actualBuyerFunds=n(settlement.actualBuyerFunds??settlement.buyerFunds); const expectedSellerPayoff=n(ctx.expectedSellerPayoff??ctx.sellerPayoff); const actualSellerPayoff=n(settlement.actualSellerPayoff??settlement.sellerPayoff); const tol=Math.max(0.01,n(ctx.reconciliationTolerance??0.01)); const deltas={assignmentFee:Math.round((actualAssignmentFee-expectedAssignmentFee)*100)/100,closingCosts:Math.round((actualClosingCosts-expectedClosingCosts)*100)/100,otherCosts:Math.round((actualOtherCosts-expectedOtherCosts)*100)/100,buyerFunds:Math.round((actualBuyerFunds-expectedBuyerFunds)*100)/100,sellerPayoff:Math.round((actualSellerPayoff-expectedSellerPayoff)*100)/100}; const mismatches=Object.entries(deltas).filter(([,v])=>Math.abs(v)>tol).map(([k,v])=>({field:k,delta:v})); if(mismatches.length)flags.push('settlement_amount_mismatch'); const grossSettlementProceeds=actualAssignmentFee; const totalClosingCosts=actualClosingCosts+actualOtherCosts; const netSettlementProceeds=Math.round((grossSettlementProceeds-totalClosingCosts)*100)/100; const fundsBalanced=Math.abs(deltas.buyerFunds)<=tol&&Math.abs(deltas.sellerPayoff)<=tol; if(!fundsBalanced)flags.push('funds_not_reconciled'); let decision='hold_for_settlement_correction',nextAction='resolve_settlement_statement_mismatches',reconciliationState='exception'; if(flags.includes('deal_or_contact_blocked')){decision='blocked';nextAction='stop_settlement_flow';reconciliationState='blocked';}else if(statementReady&&mismatches.length===0&&fundsBalanced){decision='settlement_reconciled';nextAction='advance_to_closing_completion_and_funds_confirmation';reconciliationState='reconciled';}else if(!statementReady){decision='await_final_settlement_statement';nextAction='obtain_final_approved_settlement_statement';reconciliationState='pending';} const idempotencyKey='wf446:'+input.leadId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.settlementId+':'+input.settlementEventId; return [{json:{...input,finalSettlementReconciliation:{status:reconciliationState,decision,nextAction,statementStatus,statementReady,expected:{assignmentFee:expectedAssignmentFee,closingCosts:expectedClosingCosts,otherCosts:expectedOtherCosts,buyerFunds:expectedBuyerFunds,sellerPayoff:expectedSellerPayoff},actual:{assignmentFee:actualAssignmentFee,closingCosts:actualClosingCosts,otherCosts:actualOtherCosts,buyerFunds:actualBuyerFunds,sellerPayoff:actualSellerPayoff},deltas,mismatches,grossSettlementProceeds,totalClosingCosts,netSettlementProceeds,fundsBalanced,reconciliationTolerance:tol,flags,requiresHumanReview:reconciliationState==='exception'||reconciliationState==='blocked',confidenceScore:reconciliationState==='reconciled'?99:reconciliationState==='pending'?75:25},idempotencyKey}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ {status:'blocked',reason:'leadId, dealId, contractId, settlementId and settlementEventId are required'} }}

meta.notes: Reconciles final settlement statement, assignment fee, closing costs, other costs, buyer funds and seller payoff before closing completion. Production use requires verified settlement/accounting schema, authoritative funds evidence, jurisdiction-specific closing rules and production InsulaCRM API contracts.
